message: The other night, I decided to do a little fire safety check—nothing like a smoke alarm test to get the heart racing, right? 😅 I gathered the family and turned it into a mini event, complete with popcorn and a ‘fire safety dance’ as we practiced our escape plan! It felt good knowing we were prepared, but even better that we made some fun memories in the process. Sometimes, a little safety can spark a lot of joy!
